tools.name: economyos_get_info
tools.description: Read the configured chain's contract addresses, USDC, min payment, resolution params, and Pyth feed ids. No payment.

tools.name: economyos_get_balance
tools.description: Read an address's USDC balance (defaults to this agent's address). No payment.

tools.name: economyos_get_coin
tools.description: Read a coin's name/symbol/supply/price; includes the agent's balance + permit nonce. No payment.

tools.name: economyos_get_market
tools.description: Read an OutcomeMarket's state (outcomes, curves, pot, resolution) plus the agent's per-outcome shares. No payment.

tools.name: economyos_get_bounty
tools.description: Read a bounty's reward/deadline/claims. No payment.

tools.name: economyos_resolve_did
tools.description: Resolve an agent's chain-neutral W3C DID Document (did:eos:agent:<id>): per-chain verification methods, the soulbound Passport anchored on each chain, and a reputation link. Cross-chain. No payment.

tools.name: economyos_get_did_reputation
tools.description: Canonical cross-chain reputation for an agent DID (union of per-chain activity, one score). No payment.

tools.name: economyos_get_credentials
tools.description: List the Verifiable Credentials held under an agent DID (did:eos:agent:<id>) — signed, portable stamps (PaymentReceipt, JobCompleted, …) about the agent. Each carries a compact SD-JWT-VC verifiable OFFLINE (no chain). Free — use it to vet a counterparty's track record.

tools.name: economyos_get_did_reputation_v2
tools.description: Reputation computed over the agent's held Verifiable Credential set (chain-neutral, no RPC) — parallel to the canonical on-chain-scan reputation. Returns 404 unless the server has reputation-v2 enabled. No payment.

tools.name: economyos_quote
tools.description: Exact buy/sell quote against an outcome's bonding curve. Pass usdcIn for a buy quote and/or shares for a sell quote. No payment.

tools.name: economyos_get_agent
tools.description: Read an agent identity record (controller, metadataHash) by agent id or controller address. No payment.

tools.name: economyos_get_reputation
tools.description: Read an agent's reputation summary (score, attestations given/received) by agent id or address. Defaults to this agent. Free — use it to vet a counterparty before trading with them.

tools.name: economyos_get_passport
tools.description: Read an agent's Passport card in ONE call: identity (agentId, controller, metadataHash), reputation (score, attestations received/given), and the soulbound passport NFT (hasPassport, tokenId==agentId, metadataURI). Defaults to this agent. Free. On Solana the passport is a real Metaplex NFT once mint

tools.name: economyos_get_assets
tools.description: List the assets an address currently owns — ERC-721 NFTs from the OwnershipRegistry on EVM (or a single asset by numeric id), real Metaplex NFTs on Solana (or a single asset by mint address). Defaults to this agent. Free.

tools.name: economyos_get_mandate
tools.description: Read a scoped-delegation mandate: grantor/grantee, scope hash, spend cap/spent/remaining, expiry, active. No payment.

tools.name: economyos_check_mandate
tools.description: Check whether `grantee` is authorized to perform `action` under a mandate right now (live + correct grantee + scope), and optionally whether `amount` more USDC still fits under the spend cap. Returns remainingSpend. No payment.

tools.name: economyos_get_dispute
tools.description: Read an Arbitration dispute: opener/respondent/arbiter, subject, stake, status, ruling. No payment.

tools.name: economyos_get_escrow
tools.description: Read an EscrowRouter escrow: payer/payee/arbiter, deposited/released/refunded/remaining, timeout terms. No payment.

tools.name: economyos_get_split
tools.description: Read a RevenueSplit: creator, recipients[], sharesBps[] (basis points, sum to 10000). No payment.

tools.name: economyos_get_invoice
tools.description: Read an invoice (issuer, payer, amount, dueBy, status). No payment.

tools.name: economyos_get_stream
tools.description: Read a stream (sender, recipient, rate, deposit, withdrawn, claimable). No payment.

tools.name: economyos_find_primitive
tools.description: Discover community primitives from the Primitive App Store (read on-demand from AgentRegistry attestations). Each result carries its trust label (unverified/verified), the creator's reputation score, and the effective per-call cap. Filter by category, chain, tier, or a search string. No payment. Use

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "economyos_get_credentials" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
